question: On a fresh held-out population generated under the same fixed world families and surface templates, do final-position observers retain greater cross-depth predictive transport than mean-full observers, while raw transport accuracy decays with layer separation on both surfaces?
claim_scope: Fresh generated quartets under the fixed FAS-S01 measurement distribution and existing eight families/eight observation templates/eight query templates. No claim of novel-family, novel-template, new-task, circuit, or semantic-feature generalization.

fresh_panel.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 seed label; interpret digest bytes 0..8 as one unsigned little-endian u64. Do not use wall clock, environment state, or an alternate RNG seed.

candidate_universe.construction: The complete 26,624-quartet S01-2 design, in the frozen FACTORIAL_BALANCED, BINDING_CONTEXT, BINDING_ENTITY order and with the frozen S01-2 factor, template, pair, candidate-order, and quartet semantics. S11 uses new lexical terms and S11-scoped world/quartet/event identities. No candidate may depend on S09/S10 features, probe outputs, errors, or metrics.

term_inventory.algorithm: Ordered Cartesian product, prefix outer and suffix inner; product index i is assigned to role-local term ID i for IDs 0..31 and role-local ID i-32 for IDs 32..63. Context uses product indices 0..31 and entity uses 32..63. Within each role IDs 0..15 are train-side-style and 16..31 are novel-heldout-style, preserving the parent split structure.
term_inventory.partner_rule: For role-local index i in 0..15, partner=(i+7) mod 16 within the same term split.
term_inventory.freshness_basis: All 64 S11 surface terms are distinct from all 64 sealed S01-2 surface terms; exact input-byte SHA-256 freshness is checked separately against the complete authorized ancestry denylist before panel admission.

selection.method: Class-stratified deterministic sampling without replacement from the complete candidate universe. Target class is the frozen exact target/state ID.
selection.candidate_sort_key: SHA-256(UTF-8('FAS-S11-V01|SELECT|' + decimal_target_id + '|' + canonical_candidate_key)); sort ascending by lowercase hex digest, then by ordinal ascending for a theoretical digest tie; take the exact quota for that target class.
selection.canonical_candidate_key: ASCII fields joined with '|', in this order: track_id, context_split, entity_split, family_index, relation_id, state_id, observation_template_id, query_template_id, context_pair_id, entity_pair_id, candidate_order_index, ordinal. Null pair IDs are the empty field.
selection.on_quota_or_support_failure: Fail closed and preserve the failed construction. No reseeding, replacement, quota relaxation, or post-hoc selection is permitted.
selection.minimum_panel_support: All three exact-target class quotas must match exactly; every one of the eight world-family IDs, eight observation-template IDs, and eight query-template IDs must occur at least once. Report class-by-family, class-by-track, all 64 observation/query template-pair counts, and both lexical split marginals without a post-hoc threshold.

identity_and_freshness.render_seed: SplitMix64(generator_seed_u64 XOR ordinal), using the exact S01-2 SplitMix64 implementation.
identity_and_freshness.denylist: Before admission, compare namespace-qualified world, quartet, episode, and event IDs plus exact model-visible rendered-input SHA-256 against hash-only sets from S01-2, S09, and S10 ancestry. Do not expose prior labels, features, predictions, metrics, or raw identity strings to selection.
identity_and_freshness.if_exact_denylist_unavailable: Fail closed; no freshness claim and no panel seal.

pre_extraction_gates: independent target reconstruction from serialized latent state and query semantics
A/C/E/P target, latent rule, relation, state, candidate identity/order, and quartet-isolation invariants
all exact class quotas and minimum family/template presence
zero exact rendered-input hash collisions against ancestry and within the selected panel
deterministic regeneration parity from the frozen seed and selection rule

surfaces.F: final model-visible position at each layer

feature_and_observer_path.extraction: Reuse the sealed S09 layer extraction semantics and exact-length single-row/no-padding discipline; one sequence per forward call; record input/token identities, row order, shape, feature hashes, revision, and contract hashes. Run the S09 deterministic repeat rule and verify backbone state identity before/after.
feature_and_observer_path.observer_bank: The exact 32 sealed S09 scaler-plus-linear-observer states (16 layers x M/F), loaded read-only after the fresh feature-cache seal. No fitting or modification.
feature_and_observer_path.transport_cell: For a surface s, T_s[i,j] is balanced accuracy of the unchanged source-layer i scaler-plus-probe on the fresh target representation at layer j; rows are source observer layers, columns are target representation layers; class order is [0,1,2].
feature_and_observer_path.arithmetic_and_metrics: Use the exact frozen S10/S09 numerical path, metric implementation, batch semantics, class order, and deterministic settings bound by the parent hashes. No substitute evaluator or floating-point policy.

primary_estimands.off_diagonal_transport_advantage: D_off = equally weighted mean over all 240 ordered pairs i != j of T_F[i,j] - T_M[i,j].
primary_estimands.distance_curve: For each surface s, B_s(d)=mean of T_s[i,j] over every ordered cell with abs(i-j)=d, for each integer d=1..15.
primary_estimands.distance_slope: Ordinary least-squares slope of the 15 B_s(d) values against integer d=1..15, each distance equally weighted.
primary_estimands.confirmatory_joint_rule: Replication is supported only if the simultaneous 95% interval lower bound for D_off is >0 and the simultaneous 95% interval upper bounds for both M and F distance slopes are <0. Report all three components and their intervals even if the joint rule is not met.

uncertainty.resampling_unit: Whole quartets; all four A/C/E/P event rows remain together.
uncertainty.stratification: Resample independently within exact-target classes 0, 1, and 2, with replacement, retaining the exact observed class quartet counts 1733, 1815, and 1770 per replicate.
uncertainty.shared_plan: Use the same resampled quartet indices for every surface, source layer, target layer, and primary summary.
uncertainty.rng: NumPy 2.5.3 Generator(PCG64(seed)); seed label FAS-S11-V01-BOOTSTRAP-SEED; SHA-256 f6594b9d435e14fa866626043f8898ec73c499eae05a08ce54c3538bfd595b92; seed integer 18020131653510978038 derived from digest bytes 0..8 as unsigned little-endian u64.
uncertainty.interval: For each of three primary summaries k, compute bootstrap SD s_k with ddof=1. For replicate b compute z_b=max_k(abs(theta_bk-theta_hat_k)/s_k). q is the 0.95 quantile of z using NumPy quantile(method='linear'). The simultaneous interval for k is [theta_hat_k-q*s_k, theta_hat_k+q*s_k]. Any non-finite statistic or zero/non-finite s_k fails closed.
uncertainty.scope: Intervals quantify quartet sampling uncertainty for this fixed observer bank and fixed generator. They do not quantify observer-training, model-seed, or generator-family variation.

required_reporting: complete M and F 16x16 balanced-accuracy and accuracy matrices
all 512 cell prediction hashes, support counts, class recalls, and confusion matrices
native diagonal performance and per-class recall
forward and backward transport for each distance and adjacent bidirectional transport
all 15 raw BA distance means for M/F and their paired contrasts
D_off, M slope, F slope, shared-plan simultaneous intervals, and joint rule outcome
fresh-population layerwise principal-angle trajectory for unchanged observer planes, clearly labeled fixed-observer geometry rather than a resampled outcome
identity, feature, prediction, bootstrap-plan, result-tree, and independent-verification hashes
forbidden: S11 panel generation or feature extraction before separate explicit authorization
S01/S10 test-row reuse as S11 data
adaptive mechanisms, SAE, nonlinear analysis, or circuit interpretation
new representation views, layers, templates, world families, or tasks
threshold/window selection, selective reporting, or post-result reseeding
